nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances tracking token balances inside ERC20.
Private mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances storing spend approvals inside ERC20.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total minted token supply.
Private string _name holding the ERC20 token name.
Private string _symbol holding the ERC20 token symbol.
Private string _version of the GeneratorCopyright contract holding the generator version string.
msg.sender, the untrusted caller address that drives ownership, minting and allowance logic.
ERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_) that writes _name and _symbol.
External transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer from _msgSender().
External transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) moving tokens and decreasing the caller allowance.
External approve(address spender, uint256 amount) forwarding to _approve for _msgSender().
Public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) that adds to the current allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) that subtracts from the current allowance.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) that checks balances, mutates _balances and emits Transfer.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) that increases _totalSupply and _balances[account] and emits Transfer.
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) that decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply and emits Transfer.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) that writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Internal virtual hook _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) invoked on every token movement.
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender.
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) that performs an external payable call to receiver.pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName).
SimpleERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_, uint256 initialBalance_, address payable feeReceiver_) that mints initialBalance_ to _msgSender().
Arithmetic assignment _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic assignment _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer, crediting the receiver before any external interaction.
Arithmetic assignment _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic assignment _balances[account] += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic assignment _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Arithmetic assignment _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside _burn.
Sensitive state write _allowances[owner][spender] = amount inside _approve, guarded by zero-address checks only.
Arithmetic operation currentAllowance - amount used to write the reduced allowance inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic operation _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue inside increaseAllowance.
Arithmetic operation currentAllowance - subtractedValue inside decreaseAllowance.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) made in the ServicePayer constructor to an attacker-influenced receiver address.
Constructor string parameter name_ for the token name.
Constructor string parameter symbol_ for the token symbol.
SimpleERC20 constructor uint256 parameter initialBalance_ that is minted to the deployer.
SimpleERC20 constructor address payable parameter feeReceiver_ forwarded into ServicePayer and used for the external pay call.
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) address parameter recipient.
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) uint256 parameter amount.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) address parameter sender.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) address parameter recipient.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) uint256 parameter amount.
Local uint256 currentAllowance read from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) address parameter spender.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) uint256 parameter amount written into the allowance mapping.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) address parameter spender.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) uint256 parameter addedValue added to the allowance.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) address parameter spender.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) uint256 parameter subtractedValue removed from the allowance.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) address parameter sender.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) address parameter recipient.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) uint256 parameter amount.
Local uint256 senderBalance = _balances[sender] read before debiting the sender in _transfer.

edges.reason: Context._msgSender() directly returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller into the contract.
msg.sender (via _msgSender()) is passed as the mint recipient account in SimpleERC20's _mint call.
initialBalance_ flows into _mint as the amount of tokens created for the deployer.
initialBalance_ is added into _totalSupply, an unchecked-style supply mutation site.
Constructor parameter name_ is stored into the _name state variable.
Constructor parameter symbol_ is stored into the _symbol state variable.
_transfer sender parameter indexes _balances[sender] in the senderBalance - amount subtraction.
Local senderBalance is the minuend of _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount.
amount parameter is the subtrahend in the balance debit operation.
_transfer recipient parameter indexes the credited _balances[recipient] += amount.
amount parameter is added to _balances[recipient], the credit half of the transfer.
transferFrom amount is subtracted from currentAllowance to compute the new allowance.
Local currentAllowance is the minuend of currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom.
User-supplied amount is written unchecked into _allowances[owner][spender] by _approve.
addedValue is added to the stored allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the stored allowance in decreaseAllowance.
feeReceiver_ is cast to IPayable and used as the target of the external payable pay call.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the internal _transfer call.
transfer amount parameter flows into the internal _transfer call.
transferFrom sender parameter flows into the internal _transfer call.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into the internal _transfer call.
approve spender parameter flows into the internal _approve writer.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_).
SimpleERC20 constructor inherits and invokes the ServicePayer constructor.
ServicePayer constructor executes the external IPayable(receiver).pay call.
transfer() delegates token movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom() first delegates token movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to write the reduced allowance.
approve() delegates the allowance write to the internal _approve.
increaseAllowance() calls _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance() calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
_transfer executes the sender balance subtraction.
_transfer executes the recipient balance addition.
_mint executes the _totalSupply += amount update.
_mint executes the _balances[account] += amount update.
_burn executes the _totalSupply -= amount update.
_burn executes the _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount update.
_approve writes the allowance mapping without any privileged access control.
transferFrom computes the new allowance via currentAllowance - amount.
increaseAllowance computes the new allowance via addition.
decreaseAllowance computes the new allowance via subtraction.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook callback BEFORE state updates, an extension point for reentrancy.
The constructor makes an external payable callback to an attacker-supplied receiver contract, allowing reentrant execution during construction.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only a constructor input that is immediately stored into _name; it carries no standalone security semantics.
symbol_ is only a constructor input that is immediately stored into _symbol; it carries no standalone security semantics.
initialBalance_ is a deployment-time argument consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor mint flow.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded into ServicePayer where it becomes the external pay call target.
recipient is a plain argument of transfer() that is passed straight to _transfer.
amount is a plain argument of transfer() that is passed straight to _transfer.
sender is a plain argument of transferFrom() used to index balances and allowances.
recipient is a plain argument of transferFrom() passed to _transfer.
amount is a plain argument of transferFrom() consumed by the allowance subtraction.
currentAllowance exists only to compute the reduced allowance in the transferFrom subtraction.
spender is a plain argument of approve() forwarded to _approve.
amount is the raw value written directly into the allowance mapping by _approve.
spender is a plain argument of increaseAllowance() used to index the allowance mapping.
addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
spender is a plain argument of decreaseAllowance() used to index the allowance mapping.
subtractedValue is the operand of the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
sender is a plain internal parameter of _transfer used to index _balances.
recipient is a plain internal parameter of _transfer used to index _balances.
amount is a plain internal parameter of _transfer used in both balance mutations.
senderBalance exists only as the cached minuend of the _balances[sender] subtraction.
